updates.title: Getaway Update
updates.summary: The getaway shows its area and what's too heavy for your ride, residents and cops keep up for the whole crew, and fixes from your bug reports.
added: A line on the ground shows the getaway area during a job, so you can see where the crew has to stand to leave
The getaway board shows how heavy a piece of loot your ride can take, and names anything in the back that's too heavy to count
The appraiser shows an item's weight next to its price. It's red when the item is too heavy for your ride
fixed: Residents and cops could be 2 to 3 seconds behind for everyone but the crew leader, so on your screen a cop could tase you through a wall. They keep up for everyone now
The Vintage Tractor counted for nothing in most rides and nothing said why. It weighs 2,600 kg, so only the trucks that take any weight can haul it, and the board tells you now
Loot left in the van from the last job could be grabbed again when you repeated the job. It can't be picked up until it's back in the house
You could join standing inside a walkway post in the hideout. The spawn point moved
Something you took over from another player could drop through the floor. It doesn't anymore
In VR with Hold to grab loot off, a heavy item could drop right after you grabbed it. A second press right after the grab is ignored now
VR belt gear could stay locked after a climb or after putting down something heavy. It unlocks on its own now, and holding a couch in one hand doesn't lock the belt for the other

Three night school lines that people kept asking about say what they mean now: satellite dishes are on the sides of houses, big things are wardrobes, fridges and bathtubs, and the glass perk says 50% harder

updates.title: Bank ATMs
updates.summary: The bank's ATMs can be stolen now, 10 new skins and paint jobs in the back room shop, and fixes from your bug reports.
added: The 3 ATMs in the bank lobby are loot now, worth $8,000 each. They're bolted down, so get them loose with the wrench or a hammer and haul them out to the getaway. Pulling one off the wall rings the bank's alarm and calls the cops, unless you cut the power at the breaker first
5 new gear skins in the back room shop: Blackout, Olive Drab, Whiteout, Red Carbon and Bubblegum. Hammer heads, zippers and other metal parts stay steel
5 new paint jobs for your rides: Matte Black, Gunmetal, Getaway Cab, Loan Shark and Inside Job
The new skins and paints are 250 credits each
fixed: VR punches on residents and cops often didn't count in full lobbies or at low frame rates. They count at any frame rate now
Knocking someone out took a moment to show for everyone but the crew leader. They go down the moment the hit lands now
The bank's breaker and the camera and laser buttons could be used from the other side of a wall. They only work from the room they're in now
VR players sometimes couldn't grab a tool back off their belt after picking it up off the floor, and a worn lampshade could slide down to your hip. Both stay where they're drawn now
Another player's bag or gear could shove the host's furniture around. It doesn't anymore
Old receipts on the haul board stayed half in English after switching language. They translate fully now
Some board notes ran off their paper in Japanese, Chinese and Korean. They wrap and stay on the paper now
BAIL on the HUD was translated as legal bail in Japanese, Chinese and Korean. It means run now

updates.title: Languages Update
updates.summary: The game is in Japanese, Chinese and Korean now, plus better frame rate, VR punches work again and heavy loot grabs the same way as everything else in VR.
added: Japanese, Simplified Chinese and Korean. Boards, menus, hints and hover text follow your VRChat language, or pick one on the new LANGUAGE tab on the settings board or in the Tab menu
The translations are new, if something reads wrong in your language tell us in the Discord and we'll fix it
changed: Heavy loot in VR now follows the Hold to grab loot checkbox. With it off, tap the grip to pick up a couch or chair and tap again to put it down, like other loot. With it on, you hold the grip like before

Heavy loot near your VR hand gets a white outline, and so does stuff a crewmate is carrying when you can help carry it on desktop. Anything bolted down or locked in a cage gets a red outline when your hand is near it or you look at it, so you know you have to break it loose first
Better frame rate in jobs with a full crew. Windows, doors, residents of other houses and gear sitting on the shelf don't do work when nothing is happening to them
Other players' flashlights cost a lot less. On PC up to 4 flashlights light the room and only yours and the closest one cast shadows. With Fancy lighting off it's 2
The Graphics page has separate checkboxes for bloom, color grading and vignette on PC, so you can turn off only the ones you don't want
fixed: Punching glass in VR almost never broke it. A punch that stopped at the glass didn't count, only one that went far past it. It breaks like it's supposed to now
VR punches on residents and cops count the same way, so you don't have to punch through their head
Brushing the edge of a truck ramp could launch you. It doesn't anymore
Climbing pipes, walls and roofs on desktop could spin you around. It doesn't anymore
The kitchen window on Maple couldn't be climbed from either side. It's taller now and you land past the sink counter
Climbing through a window didn't show the desktop Climb and Jump keys, and VR hands didn't plant on the sill. Both work on every window now
The gaming chair's headrest floated off the back of the chair. It sits on the backrest now

updates.title: Belt and Window Fix
updates.summary: Fixes for VR belt gear, cut windows, a stuck bank guard and loot sitting wrong in three houses.
fixed: VR players sometimes couldn't grab any gear off their belt for a while. A free hand resting near loot, a shelf or a stair rail locked every tool on both hands. Only the hand that's actually at your belt counts now
After cutting the glass you couldn't open the window from outside, so you couldn't climb in either. It opens and you can climb through now
One of the bank night guards could spawn locked inside the CCTV office and never get out. Her rounds start in the hallway outside it now
The shoe racks in the mansion walk in closet sat tipped over on top of boots. The boots stand next to them now
The outboard motor in the pawn shop fell off its stand as soon as the job loaded. It stays on the stand now
Phones, cash and other small loot on the diner's wire shelves sat tilted between the wires. The shelves are solid now
Pressing the grip in VR still caused a small hitch inside the houses, worst in the bank. It's much smaller now

updates.title: VR Grab Update
updates.summary: VR grab fixes, a hold to grab option, jobs that start once most of the crew is ready and a fix for the farm lag.
added: Hold to grab loot checkbox on the VR settings page. Loot drops when you let go of the grip instead of staying in your hand. Gear stays a toggle so its trigger still works
changed: A job starts once most of the crew is ready, so one AFK crewmate can't hold everyone up. On a tie it goes if the boss is ready. The board shows how many are ready and how many it needs

Heavy loot in reach of your free VR hand shows the pickup outline and gives a light tick. Gripping loot that's bolted down or locked in a cage gives two slow thumps, so you can tell what can't be grabbed
Reaching for loot on the floor next to your hip grabs the loot instead of pulling gear off your belt
fixed: Some VR players, mostly on PC, couldn't pick up anything heavier than cash or a console, gear got stuck on their belt and the VR hotbar put items in their hand that they couldn't use. VRChat can say you're on desktop for the first moment after you join, and the world kept believing it. It keeps checking now
Grabbing with the grip in VR froze the game for about 5 frames. It doesn't anymore
The farm map was drawing everything at once, which is why it lagged so badly after 1.5.0. It only draws what you can see now
Deadlift Camp didn't make big safes or fridges any faster to carry. Heavy stuff counts as a third of its weight for walk speed with it now, and Furniture Removal speeds up the heaviest stuff too
The crew cam TV in the hideout showed daytime sky while the crew was on a night job. It shows the night sky and fog of the house it's watching now

updates.title: Farm Window Fix
updates.summary: Fixes for the farmhouse windows, the bank locks and a few other reports.
changed: NPCs walk around you when you're hiding in Statue Mode or under the lampshade instead of bumping into you. They only push past if you're standing in the only way through
fixed: You couldn't climb in through most of the farmhouse windows from outside, and nothing could be carried through them, not even a chair. Tip a chair on its side with O or P on desktop and it fits
The bank deposit boxes and the cage gate have a lock you can see now, and you pick that lock. The cage gate's pick spot was under its lock box before
Street lamps on the bank and pawn shop maps stood out over the gutter. They're on the sidewalk now
Grandma and grandpa could end up in the same bed. They each keep their own now
The job clock ran off the edge of the status panel on desktop. It sits on its own on the row under the status now, next to the noise meter

updates.title: Old Farmhouse
updates.summary: A new uptown job is up on the whiteboards: the Old Farmhouse out in the country. There's also a job clock, a Times tab on the haul board, a switch for Double Major and a bunch of fixes from your reports.
added: Old Farmhouse, a 3 star clear out with a $10,000 goal. It needs the Uptown Jobs contract. A farmhouse with a cellar, a timber barn with a hay loft, a silo and a chicken coop, out in the fields next to the neighbors' farms

Grandma and grandpa live there. Grandpa keeps a double barrel full of rock salt, two shells and then he reloads. A hit knocks you down for a few seconds and you drop what you're holding, but he can't cuff you. Grandma phones the cops. Thanks to sugarcaneoptimistic for the shotgun grandpa idea and kyle_goodsir for keeping it non lethal
Farm loot: a grandfather clock, a butter churn, an anvil, a sewing machine, a saddle, moonshine jugs and an old tractor. The tractor carries like the piano and only fits on the semis
Job clock. The haul receipt shows how long the job took, and the job clock checkbox on the Graphics settings page puts a running clock next to the status on your screen
Times tab on the haul board with your best time, your average and dollars a minute for every map and for all jobs together. Only jobs where you hit the goal count
If you own Double Major, its card in the Back Room has a Turn Off button. With it off only your major's courses are on, the same as before you had it. Press Turn On to get every course back
Cops call out when they get suspicious and when they spot you
changed: Cops only tase you when they're facing you, and they need a moment after getting back up before they can spot you or tase you
Bags in the getaway count from their middle, so a bag rolled into a corner or up against the wall still counts
Spare gear goes back on the gear shelf between jobs
fixed: Dropped duffel bags could vanish. A bag dropped next to a wall went into it, fell out of the world and turned up back on the gear shelf. It lands at your feet now, and gear that falls out of a house mid job comes back to the drop spot
People could climb out through the hideout roof and take spare gear off the gear shelf. Getting down there respawns you and sends the gear back
In VR, belt gear stopped being grabbable whenever your hand was near a stair rail
A lockpick that snapped stayed ungrabbable on your belt in later jobs
Holding a heavy item in each hand in VR made the second one look dropped to everyone else
Heavy loot picked up in VR could look like it was still on the floor for other players for a moment, or dropped when the carrier lagged
NPCs could get stuck out of place on everyone's screen except the host's, like behind a door. They catch up now
Big amounts on the haul receipt wrapped onto two lines
The receipt paper on the haul board covered the Times tab

updates.title: Loadout and Window Fix
updates.summary: Buying a ride doesn't mess with your gear anymore, and windows stop breaking when you just walk past them.
changed: Buying a ride with cash doesn't equip it anymore. Press Equip on the rides board when you want to use it
fixed: Buying the Electric Van while you had a bigger ride equipped switched you to the van and sent your extra gear back to storage
Walking past a window or up to one while holding loot could break it. Brushing the glass doesn't count anymore, throwing or swinging something into it still breaks it

updates.title: Electric Van
updates.summary: There's a new ride, the Electric Van, every night school track gets a 5th course, and sneaky rides actually keep the cops away longer now.
added: Electric Van, a new ride between the Ambulance and the Delivery Truck. $70,000 or 650 credits, brings 3 gear, 10% driver's cut, 1,100 kg max load and full width back doors that fold flat to the sides
A 5th course on every night school track, 12 in all at $400,000 each. Double Major covers them too
Cat Burglar: Out of Range (cops have to get closer to tase you) and Night Owl (the dark hides you better from people and cameras)
Muscle: Heavy Hitter (your throws and swings break glass easier) and Fight or Flight (knock someone out and you run faster for 4 s)
Brains: Treasure Sense (the most valuable loot nearby that isn't bagged shows through walls) and Police Scanner (a countdown to the cops showing up once they're called)
Lookout: Stake Out (a quick rundown of the house when you get there) and Tight Squeeze (your bags take bigger and heavier things)
Fixer: Out of Sight (people and cameras lose track of you twice as fast) and Tripwire Tamer (cameras and lasers you set off make half the noise)
Crew Chief: Cover Me (people and cameras lose track of crewmates near you faster) and Pivot (team carries hold with you up to 2 m apart)
X-ray outlines checkbox on the Graphics settings page. Turn it off to hide every see through walls outline on your screen, your courses stay passed
changed: Ride stealth actually does something now. The boss's ride makes the cops show up later once they're called, up to 8 s later with the Basket Bike. The rides board and the plan board say how much later
The rides board says how much gear a ride brings instead of gear slots, so it doesn't read like your belt slots
The rides board goes through the rides from cheapest to most expensive
The Back Room's Rides tab has page arrows now that there are 9 keys
fixed: 16 loot items (gold chain, pocket watch, the instruments and more) and the diner key showed a number on the desktop belt instead of an icon. They all have icons now

updates.title: Taser Fix
updates.summary: Tasers work again, Statue Mode actually hides you and shows when you're hidden, there's a crew cam TV in the hideout and a belt height slider, and cops and residents stop getting stuck on each other in halls and at the Mansion garage door.
added: Make My Major button on the night school board. Flip to a major with the arrows and press it to switch
Statue Mode shows a small eye under your view when you stop moving. It turns into a crossed out eye once you're hidden
Belt up/down slider in the Belt tab, for avatars where the belt sat at your feet or in your chest, plus a Reset Belt button
Crew cam TV on the crate next to the plan board. While a job runs anyone in the hideout can watch the crew live, flip between them and turn their voice up
changed: The night school arrows only let you look through the majors now, they don't change your major
The lampshade readout is smaller and looks like the hotbar now, with the same eye
The settings board and the Tab menu are split into Audio, Graphics, Belt and VR tabs
fixed: Residents and cops couldn't see anyone in 1.4.10, so tasers never fired. They see you and tase you again
A cop dart could still get you from past the cop's range. It misses now
Flipping through the majors on the night school board switched your major, so the courses you passed in your real major stopped working
Duffels and other big gear could still land inside each other or inside a parked truck at the start of a job. Every crew member's gear gets its own clear spot now
Heavy loot someone walked away from couldn't be clicked on desktop. It can be picked up again
Closing the Hilltop Mansion garage door made npcs come check it and get stuck against the door and each other. They check it from inside the garage and go back to what they were doing
Statue Mode and the lampshade broke if you moved a few inches, so swaying, leaning or crouching in VR kept unhiding you. Only an actual step breaks it now
Spectators couldn't move from where they spawned. They can walk around the house again
Cops searching a house kept walking into each other and getting stuck on steps, doorways and halls until someone made a noise. They split up the search and move on from a spot they can't reach now

updates.title: Bug Report Fixes
updates.summary: Cops need a clear line to you before they shoot, Hidden stays hidden when a resident wakes up, and there's a Discord sign in the hideout for bug reports.
added: Discord sign on the wall left of the plan board. Click the invite and VRChat's text box opens with the link already in it so you can copy it
fixed: Cops could see and tase you through walls, floors and windows. They need a clear line to you now
Cop darts could hit you from past their range. They stop at the cop's range now
Holding still with the lampshade on Hidden got you spotted the moment a resident woke up. It keeps counting while they sleep now
The bank guard walked straight through the locked CCTV door. She walks around it while it's locked now
Two crew duffels could spawn inside each other at the start of a job and one got knocked away. Each crew member gets their own spot now
Heavy loot could stay stuck on someone who wasn't anywhere near it, so nobody else could pick it up or move it

updates.title: Footstep Fix
updates.summary: Npc footsteps are quieter and actually line up with their feet.
changed: Npc footsteps are about half as loud
Each step plays from the foot that lands instead of the middle of the body
fixed: Footsteps didn't match the walk animation. They play the moment each foot hits the ground now, walking, jogging or running

updates.title: Spectate
updates.summary: Watch a job you're not on, watch your crew from the back of the cop van, a stats tab on the haul board and footsteps on everyone in the house.
added: Spectate button on the plan board while a job is running. Anyone not on the job can drop into the house and watch. You can't pick up or touch anything, residents, guards, cops and cameras don't see you, you get a Spectator tag over your head and you can still talk to the crew. Respawn to go home

A monitor on the wall inside the cop van. If you get caught you can flip between crewmates still on the job and see what they see. Sound on turns the person you're watching up so you hear them clearly from the van

Stats tab on the haul board: time played, cash earned and spent, best payout, jobs pulled, clean escapes, times caught, times bailed out, people knocked out, alarms set off and cops called. Jobs pulled and best payout go all the way back, the rest count from this update on
Residents, guards and cops have footsteps now. They sound different on wood, tile, carpet, concrete, grass, gravel and metal, they're muffled through walls, and guards and cops have heavier boots
changed: The catwalk under the changelog board is a meter deeper so you can stand back and actually see the whole board
fixed: Players who joined in the middle of an arrest didn't see the cop van. It shows for them now

updates.title: Spawn Fix
updates.summary: Taking a big ride to Hilltop Mansion doesn't trap the crew inside it anymore.
changed: You arrive a few steps over at Hilltop Mansion again, still out of the cameras' view
fixed: At Hilltop Mansion the RV, Cargo Truck, Flatbed and Lowboy parked right on top of where the crew arrives, so everyone got stuck in the truck floor and respawning put you back in it. You arrive next to the truck now

updates.title: Cop Fix
updates.summary: Cops don't freeze in place anymore, the Mansion and Cedar cameras can't see you the second you arrive, and Bad Reception homework counts like it should.
changed: Knocking out a resident while she runs off to call the cops counts toward the Bad Reception homework now, not just the moment she's on the phone
You arrive a few steps over at Hilltop Mansion and Cedar Bungalow
fixed: Cops could freeze in place and stay standing there into the next job. They don't anymore
A security camera at Hilltop Mansion and one at Cedar Bungalow could see you as soon as you arrived. You arrive out of their view now

updates.title: Rides Board Fix
updates.summary: The rides board works again, and See Through Walls actually shows residents through walls now.
fixed: The rides board was stuck in 1.4.4. You couldn't flip through rides, buy one or switch to another. It works again
See Through Walls still missed most residents and guards. It shows all of them now

updates.title: Bag Fix
updates.summary: Bags sync for everyone again, lockpicks open the cop van again, and cop tasers stop at doors and walls.
changed: Two cops can't zap you at the same moment anymore, they space their shots out
The Lowboy's page on the rides board has a Lowboy Haul note like the Delivery Truck and Flatbed have, or Lowboy Showroom if you already own part of the Haul
fixed: Since 1.4.3 bags weren't telling other players what went in, so loot you bagged stayed hanging in the air for everyone else. They see it go in now
Lockpicks couldn't open the cop van, so anyone who got caught stayed locked in for the rest of the job. You can pick the van open again
Cop tasers could hit you through doors and walls. Darts stop at the first wall now, and a cop that can't actually see you goes looking for you instead of firing

updates.title: Extended Crew
updates.summary: Crews go up to 6 now. The Lowboy Truck is the new top ride, Night School has a sixth major called Crew Chief, and The Back Room has Job Boosts, Bundles and Holiday Lights.
added: Crews of up to 6 instead of 4. Each cop van bench has three jail seats now

The Lowboy Truck, the new top ride. A semi with a drop deck trailer and two wheel ramps that fold down to the ground, so it doesn't need the Loading Ramp. $900,000 or 2,500 credits, 6 gear slots and a 28% driver's cut
Crew Chief, a sixth major with courses that help the crew around you: Bust Out, Pep Talk, Hand Signals, Ringleader, Shared Kit, Medic, Two to Carry and Rally. Double Major covers it
Hush Money, Fixer's 8th course. Anyone you knock out wakes up dazed. Residents go back to what they were doing instead of calling it in, and guards search instead of radioing
A Job Boosts tab in The Back Room with two new instant buys. Bail Money pays your next lawyer bill. Study Group makes homework count double for your whole crew on your next job
Payday Pack, five Double Pays for 800 credits

A Bundles tab with six new bundles: Starter Kit, Lowboy Haul, Honor Roll, Lowboy Showroom, Holiday Lights Set and The Whole Operation. Side Hustle and The Big Haul are there too. If you already own part of a bundle, the board tells you and points you to the pieces you're missing
Holiday Lights paint and gear skin, dark green with strings of red, amber and green bulbs that twinkle. 250 credits each, or 400 for both in the Holiday Lights Set until January 1
New items have a red NEW tag in The Back Room until January 1
changed: The hideout bay is 6m deeper, so every ride parks at full size
In VR you point the ladder with your hand to place it. Aiming low puts up the shortest ladder, and it places on a lot more spots than before
The gear board says when your ride's slots are full instead of hiding the Equip button
All Six Paints and All Six Skins don't include Holiday Lights. Their cards name the six they cover
fixed: Loot you dropped into a crewmate's sack fell straight out. It goes in now
The lampshade could say Hidden while guards and cameras still saw you. They go by the same timer now
Truck ramps at some getaway spots hung in the air. They sit on the ground now

updates.title: Save Fix
updates.summary: Some players joined and got treated like a brand new player, and their save got overwritten. That can't happen anymore.
added: If your save doesn't load when you join, you get a "Save data failed to load" message and nothing saves until it does. Rejoin and it should load. If it shows up late it loads on its own
fixed: When VRChat took too long to send your save on join, the world started you fresh and your first job wrote over your real save. It waits for your real save now

updates.title: Lookout and Fixer
updates.summary: Night School has two new majors, Lookout and Fixer. Five courses that never worked got swapped out for new ones, and there are firecrackers in the gear shop.
added: Firecrackers in the gear shop, 3 for $350, and you can carry up to 6. Light one and after a 5 second fuse it bangs, and anyone close by comes over to check it out and look around. They come back every run like the lockpick
Lookout, a new major for watching out and packing up: Head Count, Early Warning, Engine Running, Smooth Talker, Packed Tight, Second Look, Deep Pockets and Bag Man
Fixer, a new major for security and trouble: Lefty Loosey, Quick Freeze, Limbo Lessons, Finders Keepers, Art History Minor, Nap Time and Bad Reception. The 8th course is coming soon
Five courses that never worked got swapped out for new ones: Second Wind, Iron Grip, Casing the Joint, Firework Science and Lawyer on Retainer
changed: The five skins and five paints are 250 credits each instead of 400, and All Six Skins and All Six Paints are 1,000 instead of 1,500
fixed: Selling Secrets and See Through Walls didn't do anything. They work now
A snapped lockpick fell through the floor and kept respawning over and over. It stays put now
Firecrackers you bought weren't getting handed out on jobs. You get them now
Deadlift Camp said you could pick up a car. There are no cars to steal, it makes safes, fridges and other heavy stuff a lot easier to lift, and the note says that now
Statue Mode homework only counted floor lamps. Wardrobes, cupboards, fridges, washing machines, dryers, big safes and bathtubs count now too

updates.title: Downtown Bank
updates.summary: A new big score job is up on the whiteboards: the City Savings Bank downtown. The pawn shop and the diner got overhauled, Night School has four new courses and there are two new kits in The Back Room.
added: City Savings Bank, a 4 star big score downtown with a $40,000 goal. It needs the Big Score contract
Two night guards walk the bank with radios, and if they spot you they call it in
The vault takes the manager's keycard and then a code. Lasers sweep and blink down the vault hallway
A CCTV office behind a keypad door, with kill switches for the cameras and the lasers on the console
Bank loot: gold stacks behind a gate you pick open, cash bricks, jewelry in deposit boxes you pick open, and the computers and monitors off the desks
Night School has four new courses: Nimble Fingers, Fence Contacts, Slow Response and Glass Work

Two kits in the Contracts tab of The Back Room. Side Hustle is the Delivery Truck key, the Uptown Jobs contract and $10,000 for 1,100 credits. The Big Haul is the Flatbed Truck key, the Big Score contract and $50,000 for 2,700 credits
Kit notes on the Getaway Rides board and the Uptown Jobs and Big Score cards. Click one to open the kit in the store
changed: The pawn shop is a bigger corner shop on a new city street. It has a basement with a keypad vault, a workshop, an office and a CCTV room with a camera kill switch. The vault code is written down somewhere in the shop

The diner got a basement with a cash room behind an old brass key that turns up in one of five spots, a big safe in the office and five night deposit bags. The dining room, kitchen and lot are redone and the gas station is gone
The mansion lasers move now. The low beam blinks and the middle one sweeps
Intel is free twice after a run, then costs $250 and doubles each time up to $16,000
The ladder reaches about 6.5m, high enough for the bank's upstairs windows
Blending In slows a cop spotting you up close too, not just from far away
The box trucks and semis got redone grilles, frames and trailer doors
A bag on your belt slows you down too now, just a bit less than holding it since it's on your waist
fixed: The wrench didn't work on any map. It works everywhere again
The loading ramp didn't work at the diner. It does now
Cops could tase you through walls. They have to actually see you now
Knocked out cops sometimes got back up. They stay down like they're supposed to
Deadlift Camp and Shot Put homework couldn't be finished. They can now
From some rooms the night sky disappeared
The buy and put on buttons hung off the bottom of the shop info note. They sit on the paper now
Some surfaces flickered on Quest. They stay put now

updates.title: 24 Hour Diner
updates.summary: A new uptown job is up on the whiteboards: the 24 Hour Diner out on the highway. There's also a loading ramp for your getaway, a much roomier Old RV, and more stuff knocks people out.
added: 24 Hour Diner, a 3 star smash and grab that needs the Uptown contract. A chrome dining car with booths and a counter, a kitchen line, restrooms, a storage room and an office, with a truck lot and a closed gas station out on the highway
A cook works the grill and a waitress works the floor on the night shift. Both go out back for smokes, and if they spot you they phone the cops
Diner loot: a cash register, a coffee brewer, a milkshake mixer, a deep fryer, the neon sign out of the window and a commercial toilet you can rip out
Loading Ramp in the gear shop for $25,000. Carry it to the back of the getaway and it folds out down to the ground, tailgates drop for it, so you can walk heavy stuff up instead of lifting it
changed: The Old RV is gutted from behind the cab seats back to the ramp door, so it actually holds more than the ambulance and the delivery truck like the rides board says
More stuff knocks people out. Dumbbells, kettlebells and gold bars do it in one hit, bottles, guitars, kettles and that kind of thing in two
Mansion loot is worth a lot less. Gold bars are $5,000, the grand piano $40,000 and the old master $30,000. A full clear was paying way too much
fixed: The mansion guard slid through the floor on his way to the basement. He walks down like he's supposed to now
NPCs stopped to open doors they weren't even going through. They only stop for a door they're walking through now
The Cedar back door hit the plant, and Maple and Cabin doors swung into the wall and furniture. They stop before them now

updates.title: Playtest Fixes
updates.summary: Changes from your playtest feedback, plus fixes.
changed: Anyone in the crew who isn't locked up can hit the getaway button now, not just the crew leader
The duffel bag takes loot up to 25kg now, so gold bars, typewriters, dumbbells and guitar amps go in. In VR you can drop a heavy carry straight into it. The loot sack still takes up to 10kg
Residents and guards close doors you left open when they walk past
The mansion front door is a big pair of double doors that swing out onto the porch. One lock holds both, and a click throws them all the way open so the grand piano fits through
fixed: On desktop, holding the click on the glass cutter didn't cut a locked window. It cuts like it's supposed to now
Some gear waiting in storage kept falling out of the world and respawning over and over the whole session, which kept the network busy for whoever owned it

updates.title: Glass Cutter Fix
updates.summary: Fixes for the mansion update.
fixed: The glass cutter didn't work on any window on any map. It works everywhere again, the mansion too
The mansion guard said he had someone in the pawn shop when he radioed it in. He says the mansion now

updates.title: Hilltop Mansion
updates.summary: A new big score job is up on the whiteboards: the Hilltop Mansion. There's a new top ride to haul it all, job contracts, paint jobs for your rides and a VR hotbar.
added: Hilltop Mansion, a 4 star big score. Two floors plus a basement with a wine cellar, a security room and a vault, a garage, a pool, a fountain out front and a long drive up the hill
A rich couple sleeps upstairs and a guard walks his rounds. Tripwire lasers in the basement make a racket when you cross them, and they go dark when you cut the power at the breaker
The vault door opens with a colored keycard. One is hidden somewhere in the house every run, so find the one that matches the reader
Big score loot: gold bars, an old master and two more paintings, a marble bust, an ancient urn, vintage wine, whiskey decanters, a jeweled goblet, a grand piano and a motorbike
Flatbed Truck, the new top ride. A semi pulling an open flatbed trailer with 6 gear slots and no weight limit. $600,000 or 2,000 credits

Job contracts. A new board next to the jobs board sells Uptown Jobs for $40,000 and Big Score for $150,000, or 500 and 1,000 credits. The crew leader's contracts decide which jobs come up, and your contact takes a cut of the haul, 5% on Uptown and 15% on Big Score
Paint jobs. Six paints for your rides on their own tab on the shop board, or all six together. The getaway wears your paint when you lead the crew
VR hotbar. Turn it on in the tab menu settings and your belt slots float low in front of you. Point at one and click and the item floats into your hand
The tab menu has a crew strip with a Ready up button, so you don't have to walk over to the plan board
Menus and boards make sounds now, a click on buttons and a page flip on tabs and page buttons
changed: Second Chance Pawn is an Uptown job now and needs the Uptown contract. Maple Street, Cedar Bungalow and Lakeside Cabin stay free
Windows have a new latch and sills, and from inside you can click the glass to unlock them
The cop van has barred windows you can actually see out of, a push bar on the bumper and headlights that light up
The gear page in the tab menu shows your loadout slots
fixed: In VR, grabbing a window or walking past one could break the glass. You have to swing a closed fist into it now
Loot could spawn inside the Cedar Bungalow chimney or under the TV

updates.title: Board Fixes
updates.summary: Small fixes for the hideout boards.
changed: The supporters list on the shop board is two columns now and scrolls round on a loop instead of rewinding back to the top
fixed: Names on the supporters list ran off the bottom of the paper
Gear prices like 4 for $1,000 didn't fit inside their circle on the gear board
The Or credits button on the rides board sat on top of the You ride note

updates.title: Cops and Cases
updates.summary: More pawn shop fixes, and the cops are a lot better at getting around.
added: The pawn shop cases have ring trays and necklace busts in them now, and you can take them
changed: Cops search the house properly now. They go from room to room instead of standing around or wandering back and forth
fixed: In VR you couldn't grab stuff out of a pawn shop case you had just smashed yourself
You could grab loot through the pawn shop walls from outside
Respawning during a job sent you back to the hideout. It puts you back at the house now
Cops walked through parked cars, open doors and the getaway board
For other players, cops could look like they walked through walls
You could walk straight through the parked cars, bins and bench outside the pawn shop

updates.title: Bags and Bolts
updates.summary: Fixes for the pawn shop update. Bags work on every map now, bolted down stuff actually comes loose, and you can see how close it is.
added: Hitting something bolted down shows a ring for how close it is to coming loose
In VR, bringing a hammer or the wrench close to something bolted down shows a Bolted down tag over it
fixed: Duffel bags and loot sacks wouldn't take loot on Maple Street or at the pawn shop. They work on every map now
Once one bolted down thing ripped free, nothing else bolted down in that house could be hit for the rest of the session
Hammer swings in VR only counted the first hit on big bolted things like the AC unit
The pawn shop guard dropped through the floor when he came back down from upstairs. He takes the stairs now
You could walk into the buildings next to the pawn shop and fall out of the map

updates.title: Second Chance Pawn
updates.summary: A new job is up on the whiteboards: Second Chance Pawn, a corner pawn shop on a little high street. Five new tools are in the gear shop too.
added: Second Chance Pawn, a 3 star smash and grab. Glass cases full of jewellery and watches, a guitar wall, an arcade corner, a stock room, an office and storage upstairs, and a back alley with a fire escape

The shop has a roller shutter you raise with a switch inside, an old bell alarm that goes off on any break and calls the cops, and a night guard who walks his rounds and radios it in. The cops take longer to show up here
14 new loot pieces from the pawn shop, like guitars, an amp, a trumpet, a sax, a turntable, a jukebox and an arcade cabinet
Wrench. Hold it on something bolted down and it unbolts it slowly and quietly, instead of the loud rip you get with the hammer
Ladder. Aim at a wall and a ghost shows where it goes, click and it opens out to reach there, then climb it
Appraiser 3000. Point it at loot and pull the trigger and a screen pops up with its name and price
Lamp Disguise. Wear the lampshade and keep still for two seconds, and residents, guards and cameras look right past you
Glass Cutter. Stick it on a locked window and wind it round. It quietly cuts a hole so you can reach in and undo the latch. On desktop hold left click on it, in VR it winds itself
changed: Perks are a lot weaker. Running Away 101 had you sprinting way too fast in VR, and the jump and carry perks were too strong as well
fixed: Only the crew leader could knock out residents and guards. Everyone in the crew can now
The spotted warning only showed for the crew leader when a resident ran off to call the cops
VR players could shove other people's loot around for a moment when grabbing it or bumping into it

updates.title: First release
updates.summary: Break-n-Haul is out. Get a crew of up to 4 together, pick a house off the whiteboards, break in, haul the loot out to your ride and get away before the cops show up.
added: Three houses to rob: Maple Street, Cedar Bungalow and the Lakeside Cabin. Each one has its own street, its own residents and its own security, and the loot, doors and windows change every run
Small loot goes in your hands or your bag. Big stuff like TVs and microwaves slows you down, and the heaviest things need two people to carry
Loot Sack and Duffel Bag. They hold small loot and get heavier as you fill them
Lots of ways in: pick locks, smash windows, slide them open from inside, or climb drainpipes, ledges and trellises to get in upstairs
Residents sleep until something wakes them up. They come and check on noise and call the cops if they catch you
Security cameras that set off the alarm. Knock them down or cut the power at the breaker box
Cops show up, chase you down and lock you in the back of the van. Your crew can break you out
Seven getaway rides, from the Basket Bike up to the Cargo Truck. Bigger rides carry more but the driver takes a bigger cut
Gear shop with lockpicks, bags, a hammer, a flashlight and a head lamp
Night School. Pick a major, take courses, do the homework on jobs and graduate for perks
The Back Room. Gear skins, Supporter and Crew Tags, Double Pay, Crew Boost, ride keys, Hall Pass and Double Major
Your cash, gear, rides and school progress save between visits
Hold Tab on desktop or push the right stick up in VR for the menu with your gear and settings
The haul board shows your waiting boosts and a receipt of your last job with every bonus on it
This board, up on the catwalk over the hideout boards. It shows what changed in every update
